unmetGate.summary: Product main status/cancel IPC and viewer focus/close request completion were not measured.
unmetGate.evidence: The S22 Electron scenario calls OwnerWorkerController.query('get_status'), OwnerWorkerController.cancel(), BrowserWindow.focus(), and BrowserWindow.close() directly. Its reported numbers apply to the isolated owner and test windows, not the application request handlers.
unmetGate.handoff: Keep #45 open. After #43, #46, and #49 product cutover, measure the real status/cancel IPC and viewer focus/close completion events against the same limits.

limits: The isolated owner evidence does not establish application-wide DB-free status/focus/close or close #45. FR-DOC-019 and IR-APP-013 remain incomplete.
